plugins.name: first-flight
plugins.description: Spec-driven flow for building websites from scratch. Step 0 problem-definition (first-flight-grill) followed by 6 spec sub-skills (BRIEF → PRD → DESIGN → ARCHITECTURE → CONTENT → AGENTS); 1 additional sub-skill (first-flight-phases) manages complex coding work as plan + phase documents with a PR Readiness Gate, reused for every later iteration.
